verdict.rationale: Postman's docs say teams can create internal workspaces where members share, version, and discuss their work (postman-docs-18). Workspaces are described as the way to collaborate with teammates (postman-docs-21), with roles and permissions set at team, workspace, and element level (postman-docs-14), and live sessions add real-time collaboration (postman-docs-13). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how collections sync across team members' workspaces, and independent hands-on corroboration of shared-workspace collection syncing.
